mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attachment ( file_ext, file_path, file_name, file_real_name, file_size, content_id ) VALUES ( #{fileExt}, #{filePath}, #{fileName}, #{fileRealName}, #{fileSize}, #{contentId} )
mapper.select: SELECT file_id AS fileId, file_ext AS fileExt, file_path AS filePath, file_name AS fileName, file_real_name AS fileRealName, file_size AS fileSize, content_id AS contentId, created_at AS createdAt FROM attachment WHERE content_id = #{noticeId} ORDER BY created_at ASC

SELECT file_id AS fileId, file_ext AS fileExt, file_path AS filePath, file_name AS fileName, file_real_name AS fileRealName, file_size AS fileSize, content_id AS contentId, created_at AS createdAt FROM attachment WHERE file_id = #{fileId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attachment WHERE content_id = #{noticeId}
